title: Pet Wash in the park
content: Anybody else have Mallworld pets? I have a Golden Retriever puppy named Vexal the Cuteness Overlord. Today, I took him to a new pet groomer in my Mallworld city, where I live. Think New York meets Boston or Salem. Anyway, this groomer had set up a place right off the main park in the City, in what looked like a few of those "temporary classrooms" that any USA millennial will know. They'd retrofitted the longest one with what I can only describe as a semi-automated car wash for pets. Like, we checked in, the groomers gave him a brush down and then he was loaded up onto a sort of conveyor belt, and sent through a machine that hosed him down, lathered him up really well, then rinsed him off. The groomers then did the blow dry, final brushing, and a little blueberry pet cologne. And some other volunteers spoiled him with pets and massages and (approved) treats. Vexxie LOVED it. He was all wagging tail and snapping at the water and absolutely melted under the scrubber brushes during his lather. The other buildings contained separate check-in areas for cats and dogs, and the groomer even included play rooms for those pets who were social, and smaller, more private areas for nervous or antisocial pets. His Cuteness met a new minion, I mean friend, in a pug named Cupcake. When I went to pick him up after our appointment, he was standing there with his pug follower, wagging his tail and grinning. I want to go back, again, soon!
